shell.changelog: Beta 0.2.0-beta.14: theme changes now reach the shell and mini-apps. The theme.css generator always returned an empty :root on Android because Rhino passes Java strings as wrapper objects and the generator checked typeof === "string"; it now converts the value explicitly, and a regression test covers the wrapper case. Mini-apps (launcher, market, console, dialogs, browser, sample game) load theme.css and read --mapp-* tokens through --app-* aliases. The theme editor is styled through the same tokens, so edits repaint the editor at once. Verified in headless Chromium with the shell's wiring (tests/e2e-theme, 8/8). Not yet verified on a physical device.
